selection: Sort SHA256(visiora-object-eval-v1:+numeric image id) lexicographically; first 12 in each of five disjoint annotation strata

metrics.matching: greedy predictions descending score, one ground-truth box per match; iscrowd ignores overlapping unmatched detections; all sizes; no AP claimed

limitations: Small stratified convenience sample, not representative prevalence
COCO is source validation data for YOLOX; no independent Brazilian camera validation
Not an accessibility or safety test
CPU shared: timings exploratory, not controlled benchmark
